finding.detail: H3 semantic receipt normalization treats any cuda-prefixed device, including cuda:1, as cuda. Converter v4 later rejects it against plan cuda (canonical cuda:0), so no erroneous endpoint result is emitted, but receipt validation is not exact and failure is delayed until statistic conversion.
finding.minimal_fix: Use converter-equivalent device canonicalization in semantic receipt validation; add public H3 cuda:1 rejection-before-CSV test.
